structural_finding: K(Ψ)=exp(-αΨ²) does NOT resolve the frozen-field problem. 'Viable' solutions require Ψ_ini ∈ [1.84, 2.57] M_Pl — the field starts within 0.78 M_Pl of the target Ψ₀=2.62 and barely rolls. This is fine-tuning, not dynamics. The hilltop bottleneck (Ψ≈0, K≈1, V'≈0, H large) is unchanged by the kinetic modification. Furthermore, all viable H(z=0) are unphysically large (up to ~10⁶ km/s/Mpc), so no CMB acoustic scale match exists. Conclusion: non-canonical K(Ψ)=exp(-αΨ²) kinetics cannot fix the Phase 2 frozen-field inconsistency. A fundamentally different potential or coupling structure is required.
